lines.name: DRAGHKAR
lines.text: Why won't you sleep, little one?

lines.name: FADE
lines.text: Run, boy. The Eyeless are patient.

lines.name: BE'LAL
lines.text: You dare strike one of the Chosen?

lines.name: TWINKLE TOES
lines.text: Riley! I can see the lightning!

lines.name: TWINKLE TOES
lines.text: Like a dance step. Got it!

lines.name: TWINKLE TOES
lines.text: Ready when you are, big brother!

lines.name: MOIRAINE
lines.text: The Wheel turned in our favor.

lines.name: MOIRAINE
lines.text: The tower is falling. Stay together!

lines.name: MOIRAINE
lines.text: Riley, the Shadow has taken Twinkle Toes.

lines.name: MOIRAINE
lines.text: The road is open. The Shadow fled east.

lines.name: NARRATOR
lines.text: Emond's Field, on Winternight. The Two Rivers sleeps, but the Shadow is on the road.

lines.name: NARRATOR
lines.text: Caemlyn, the great city of Andor. Somewhere in its crowded streets, a Fade is hiding.

lines.name: NARRATOR
lines.text: Shadar Logoth. A city lost long ago, where the silver fog still creeps.

lines.name: NARRATOR
lines.text: The Stone of Tear. No army has ever taken it. Deep inside, Callandor waits.

lines.name: NARRATOR
lines.text: The roof of the Black Tower. The storm is gathering. The Wheel turns, and the last battle begins.

lines.name: MAZRIM TAIM
lines.text: Bring the child to the Black Tower.
